feature.name: Activity Feed Smoke Test
feature.description: Test story to verify the live activity feed displays tool usage during the loop

stories.title: Add RALPH_LOOP_VERSION constant to utils.sh
stories.description: Add a RALPH_LOOP_VERSION constant set to '2' in ralph/utils.sh, near the existing RALPH_VERSION constant. This tracks the loop protocol version for the stream-json activity feed.
acceptanceCriteria: Value is set to the string '2'
Constant is defined near RALPH_VERSION at the top of the file
constraints: Do not modify any other constants
Place the new constant immediately after the RALPH_VERSION lines

stories.title: Add --quiet flag to CLI help text
stories.description: Add documentation for the --quiet flag in the CLI help output. The help text is in bin/agentic-loop.sh in the usage/help function. Add --quiet as a documented option that suppresses the live activity feed during loop execution.
acceptanceCriteria: The help text in bin/agentic-loop.sh mentions --quiet
The description says it suppresses the activity feed
The flag appears near the other run flags (--max, --story, --fast)
constraints: Only modify the help/usage text, do not change any logic
Match the existing formatting style of other flags in the help output
